grammar.title: 汉语, 中文, and 汉字
grammar.pattern: 汉语/中文 (the language) vs 汉字 (the characters)
grammar.explanation: 汉语 (Hànyǔ) and 中文 (Zhōngwén) both mean "the Chinese language" and are largely interchangeable in speech. 汉字 (Hànzì) refers specifically to Chinese written characters, not the spoken language.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng jì zhù wǒ de míngzi.
